# Overview

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin by Team
import pandas as pd
from itables import show
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.sort_values('date').copy()
df_sorted = df_sorted.groupby('team').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['Total Picks'] = df_sorted.over_picks + df_sorted.under_picks
df_sorted['ROI'] = df_sorted.profit/(df_sorted['Total Picks']*10)
df_sorted.ROI = round((df_sorted.ROI*100),1)
df_sorted = df_sorted.sort_values(by='ROI',ascending=False)
df_sorted = df_sorted[['team','ROI','Total Picks']]
show(df_sorted,searching=False,ordering=True,showIndex=False,info=False)
```

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin By Bet Type
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('over_pick != 0 or under_pick != 0')
final_ratings_test['type'] = final_ratings_test.apply(lambda row: 'Over' if row['over_pick'] ==1 else 'Under', axis = 1)
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('type').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),opicks=('over_pick','sum'),upicks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['roi'] = round((df_sorted.profit/(df_sorted.opicks+df_sorted.upicks)*10),1)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['type'],
    y=df_sorted['roi']
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="ROI")
```

## Row 

```{python}
#| title: Cumulative Units of Profit for Test Data
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.sort_values('date').copy()
df_sorted['date'] = df_sorted['date'].astype(str)
df_sorted = df_sorted.groupby('date').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['cumulative_profit'] = df_sorted['profit'].cumsum()
df_sorted['cumulative_profit']= df_sorted['cumulative_profit']/10

fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_sorted['date'],
    y=df_sorted['cumulative_profit'],
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='steelblue', width=3)
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="Units",
    xaxis=dict(type='category', tickangle=45, nticks=10)
)
```

# OversUnders

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin By Edge Bin (Overs)
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('over_pick == 1')
final_ratings_test['over%'] = final_ratings_test.apply(lambda row: 'Over 5.5% Edge' if row['over_diff'] >= .055 else 'Under 5.5% Edge', axis = 1)
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('over%').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),picks=('over_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['roi'] = round((df_sorted.profit/df_sorted.picks*10),1)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['over%'],
    y=df_sorted['roi']
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="ROI")
```
